text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide has rebuilt her<n>winning equation
from the ground up<n>in preparation for the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During that process, she has gained a<n>newfound
intensity. Even Narita<n>Taishin and Winning Ticket
can't help<n>but notice the difference.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The BNW showdown is about to take<n>place in the
final Classic race, and<n>sparks are sure to fly!
